$comment: Agent notes for chat info: chat settings, pins, member read-out, boosts, verification, user profile reads. Shape and rules: scripts/api_notes.py. Every pitfall carries its source label; API means the catalog text quoted in cite.

setChatPhoto.purpose: Upload a new photo for a group, supergroup or channel.
use_when: branding a chat the bot administers, e.g. a seasonal avatar
avoid_when: private chats: their photos can't be changed
removing the photo: deleteChatPhoto

pitfalls.text: photo is InputFile only: a new multipart upload, never a file_id or URL.
pitfalls.cite: photo: New chat photo, uploaded using multipart/form-data

pitfalls.text: The method names no right; can_change_info covers the chat photo.
pitfalls.cite: ChatAdministratorRights.can_change_info: allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings

pitfalls.text: Earlier ChatPhoto file ids stop working once the photo changes; re-read getChat.
pitfalls.cite: ChatPhoto.small_file_id: can be used only for photo download and only for as long as the photo is not changed

setChatPhoto.rights: admin with can_change_info (ChatAdministratorRights: title, photo and other settings)

deleteChatPhoto.purpose: Remove the photo of a group, supergroup or channel.
use_when: going back to the default chat avatar
avoid_when: replacing the photo: setChatPhoto does it in one call

pitfalls.text: Photos can't be changed for private chats.
pitfalls.cite: deleteChatPhoto: Photos can't be changed for private chats.

pitfalls.text: The method names no right; can_change_info covers the chat photo.
pitfalls.cite: ChatAdministratorRights.can_change_info: allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings

pitfalls.text: To allow an undo, download ChatPhoto.big_file_id first; the id dies with the photo.

deleteChatPhoto.rights: admin with can_change_info (ChatAdministratorRights: title, photo and other settings)

setChatTitle.purpose: Rename a group, supergroup or channel; 1-128 characters.
use_when: an event or season renames a chat the bot runs

pitfalls.text: title is 1-128 characters; private chats can't be renamed.
pitfalls.cite: title: New chat title, 1-128 characters; setChatTitle: Titles can't be changed for private chats.

pitfalls.text: The method names no right; can_change_info covers the title.
pitfalls.cite: ChatAdministratorRights.can_change_info: allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings

pitfalls.text: A rename shows up as a service message with Message.new_chat_title.
pitfalls.cite: Message.new_chat_title: A chat title was changed to this value

setChatTitle.rights: admin with can_change_info (ChatAdministratorRights: title, photo and other settings)

setChatDescription.purpose: Change the description of a group, supergroup or channel; 0-255 characters.
use_when: keeping the chat's About text in sync with the bot's rules or schedule

pitfalls.text: description is optional and 0-255 characters.
pitfalls.cite: description: New chat description, 0-255 characters

pitfalls.text: That omitting description or sending "" clears it is implied by the 0 minimum, not stated.
The method names no right; can_change_info covers 'other settings' (the description is not named there).
pitfalls.cite: ChatAdministratorRights.can_change_info: allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings

setChatDescription.rights: admin with can_change_info (ChatAdministratorRights: 'other settings'; the method says only 'appropriate rights')

pinChatMessage.purpose: Add a message to a chat's pinned list.
use_when: a rules post, digest or live status that should stay on top
avoid_when: a message sent via inline mode: the method takes chat_id and message_id only

pitfalls.text: Groups need can_pin_messages, channels can_edit_messages; private and channel direct messages chats need none.
pitfalls.cite: pinChatMessage: the bot must be an administrator with the 'can_pin_messages' right or the 'can_edit_messages' right to pin messages in groups and channels respectively

pitfalls.text: disable_notification only matters in groups: channels and private chats never notify.
pitfalls.cite: disable_notification: Notifications are always disabled in channels and private chats.

pitfalls.text: A group pin notifies every member; pass disable_notification unless it is urgent.

pinChatMessage.rights: groups: can_pin_messages; channels: can_edit_messages; private chats: none

unpinChatMessage.purpose: Remove one message from a chat's pinned list.
use_when: a pinned post is out of date
avoid_when: clearing every pin: unpinAllChatMessages

pitfalls.text: Without message_id the most recent pin by sending date goes, maybe not the one meant; pass it.
pitfalls.cite: message_id: If not specified, the most recent pinned message (by sending date) will be unpinned.

pitfalls.text: message_id is required with business_connection_id.
pitfalls.cite: message_id: Required if business_connection_id is specified.

pitfalls.text: Groups need can_pin_messages, channels can_edit_messages; private chats need none.
pitfalls.cite: unpinChatMessage: the bot must be an administrator with the 'can_pin_messages' right or the 'can_edit_messages' right

unpinChatMessage.rights: groups: can_pin_messages; channels: can_edit_messages; private chats: none

unpinAllChatMessages.purpose: Clear the whole pinned list of a chat.
use_when: a reset of a private chat's pinned status messages
avoid_when: one pin should go: unpinChatMessage with message_id

pitfalls.text: Groups need can_pin_messages, channels can_edit_messages; private and channel direct messages chats need none.
pitfalls.cite: unpinAllChatMessages: In private chats and channel direct messages chats, no additional rights are required

pitfalls.text: It clears pins set by everyone, not just the bot; ask a human admin first in groups.

unpinAllChatMessages.rights: groups: can_pin_messages; channels: can_edit_messages; private chats: none

leaveChat.purpose: Make the bot leave a group, supergroup or channel.
use_when: the bot was added to a chat that isn't allowlisted
avoid_when: a channel direct messages chat: leave the corresponding channel

pitfalls.text: Channel direct messages chats aren't supported; leave the channel instead.
pitfalls.cite: chat_id: Channel direct messages chats aren't supported; leave the corresponding channel instead.

pitfalls.text: Treat it as final: log the chat id, who added the bot and why, then tell the operator.

getChat.purpose: Read up-to-date ChatFullInfo for a user, group, supergroup or channel.
use_when: a feature needs one field now (bio, linked_chat_id, permissions, pinned_message)
checking can_set_sticker_set before setChatStickerSet
avoid_when: reading every user in bulk 'to have the data'

pitfalls.text: Returns ChatFullInfo, not Chat.
pitfalls.cite: getChat: Returns a ChatFullInfo object on success.

pitfalls.text: @username works only for supergroups and channels; users and groups need the numeric id.
pitfalls.cite: chat_id: Unique identifier for the target chat or username of the target supergroup or channel in the format @username

pitfalls.text: Many fields are per chat type or admin-only; a missing field is an answer, not an error.
pitfalls.cite: ChatFullInfo.has_visible_history: available only to chat administrators

getChatAdministrators.purpose: List a chat's administrators as ChatMember objects.
use_when: showing or checking the whole admin team at once
avoid_when: one user or the bot itself: getChatMember

pitfalls.text: Other bots are omitted unless return_bots is True (10.0).
pitfalls.cite: return_bots: By default, bots other than the current bot are omitted.

pitfalls.text: A creator item (ChatMemberOwner) has no can_* flags yet holds every right; don't read missing flags as False.
pitfalls.cite: ChatMemberOwner: Represents a chat member that owns the chat and has all administrator privileges.

pitfalls.text: Cache briefly and refresh on chat_member updates; rights change without notice to the bot otherwise.

getChatMemberCount.purpose: Read the number of members in a chat.
use_when: a member counter or a size threshold

pitfalls.text: Returns a plain Integer.
pitfalls.cite: getChatMemberCount: Returns Integer on success.

pitfalls.text: Old code may call getChatMembersCount: renamed in 5.3, the old name still works.
pitfalls.cite: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api-changelog#june-25-2021

pitfalls.text: A count, not a list: no method lists ordinary members; track joins via chat_member.

getChatMember.purpose: Read one user's status and rights in a chat as a ChatMember.
use_when: a membership gate: join the channel to continue
the bot checks its own rights before acting (user_id = the bot's id)
avoid_when: listing the admin team: getChatAdministrators

pitfalls.text: Only guaranteed for other users when the bot is an administrator in the chat.
pitfalls.cite: getChatMember: The method is only guaranteed to work for other users if the bot is an administrator in the chat.

pitfalls.text: Branch on status: creator, administrator, member, restricted, left, kicked.
pitfalls.cite: ChatMemberBanned.status: always “kicked”

pitfalls.text: restricted may still be in the chat: check is_member.
pitfalls.cite: ChatMemberRestricted.is_member: True, if the user is a member of the chat at the moment of the request

setChatStickerSet.purpose: Set the group sticker set of a supergroup.
use_when: a community's own stickers for every member
avoid_when: groups and channels: supergroups only

pitfalls.text: Check ChatFullInfo.can_set_sticker_set from getChat first.
pitfalls.cite: setChatStickerSet: Use the field can_set_sticker_set optionally returned in getChat requests to check if the bot can use this method.

pitfalls.text: sticker_set_name is StickerSet.name (the short name), not its title.
pitfalls.cite: StickerSet.name: Sticker set name; StickerSet.title: Sticker set title

setChatStickerSet.rights: admin; the method names no right and points to can_set_sticker_set (can_change_info covers 'other settings')

deleteChatStickerSet.purpose: Remove the group sticker set from a supergroup.
use_when: the group should stop offering its sticker set
avoid_when: deleting a sticker set itself: deleteStickerSet (sets the bot created)

pitfalls.text: Check ChatFullInfo.can_set_sticker_set from getChat first.
pitfalls.cite: deleteChatStickerSet: Use the field can_set_sticker_set optionally returned in getChat requests to check if the bot can use this method.

deleteChatStickerSet.rights: admin; the method names no right and points to can_set_sticker_set (can_change_info covers 'other settings')

getUserChatBoosts.purpose: List the boosts one user added to a chat.
use_when: a perk for a user while their boost lasts
avoid_when: tracking every booster: chat_boost and removed_chat_boost updates

pitfalls.text: Needs admin rights; can_manage_chat ('get boost list') is implied by any admin right.
pitfalls.cite: ChatAdministratorRights.can_manage_chat: ...get boost list... Implied by any other administrator privilege.

pitfalls.text: Boosts expire at ChatBoost.expiration_date unless Premium is prolonged; re-check before a perk.
pitfalls.cite: ChatBoost.expiration_date: when the boost will automatically expire, unless the booster's Telegram Premium subscription is prolonged

verifyChat.purpose: Verify a bot, supergroup or channel on behalf of the organization the bot represents.
use_when: the bot represents a verification organization and the chat passed its checks
avoid_when: an ordinary bot: it represents no organization
verifying a person: verifyUser

pitfalls.text: custom_description is 0-70 characters and must be empty if the organization may not set one.
pitfalls.cite: custom_description: 0-70 characters. Must be empty if the organization isn't allowed to provide a custom verification description.

pitfalls.text: Only text_link entities, via parse mode or entities (10.4).
pitfalls.cite: custom_description_entities: Only “text_link” entities are supported.

pitfalls.text: Channel direct messages chats can't be verified.
pitfalls.cite: chat_id: Channel direct messages chats can't be verified.

verifyUser.purpose: Verify a user on behalf of the organization the bot represents.
use_when: the bot represents a verification organization and the person passed its checks
avoid_when: an ordinary bot: it represents no organization
verifying a chat or bot: verifyChat

pitfalls.text: custom_description is 0-70 characters and must be empty if the organization may not set one.
pitfalls.cite: custom_description: 0-70 characters. Must be empty if the organization isn't allowed to provide a custom verification description.

pitfalls.text: Only text_link entities, via parse mode or entities (10.4).
pitfalls.cite: custom_description_entities: Only “text_link” entities are supported.

pitfalls.text: Log who approved each verification and why; removal is removeUserVerification.

removeChatVerification.purpose: Remove the verification the bot's organization gave a chat.
use_when: a verified chat no longer meets the organization's checks

pitfalls.text: Only verification made on behalf of the bot's organization can be removed.
pitfalls.cite: removeChatVerification: a chat that is currently verified on behalf of the organization represented by the bot

pitfalls.text: The @username form names a bot or channel only (verifyChat also lists supergroups); removing a supergroup's verification by numeric id is untested.
Public and hard to undo socially: confirm with a human, log the reason.

removeUserVerification.purpose: Remove the verification the bot's organization gave a user.
use_when: a verified person no longer meets the organization's checks

pitfalls.text: Only verification made on behalf of the bot's organization can be removed.
pitfalls.cite: removeUserVerification: a user who is currently verified on behalf of the organization represented by the bot

pitfalls.text: Public and hard to undo socially: confirm with a human, log the reason.

getUserProfilePhotos.purpose: Read a user's profile pictures, paged with offset and limit.
use_when: showing the avatar a feature needs, e.g. a profile card
avoid_when: a trust or identity check on its own

pitfalls.text: limit is 1-100 (default 100); page with offset against total_count.
pitfalls.cite: limit: Values between 1-100 are accepted. Defaults to 100.

pitfalls.text: Each photo is an array of up to 4 PhotoSize; pick the size, then getFile.
pitfalls.cite: UserProfilePhotos.photos: Requested profile pictures (in up to 4 sizes each)

getUserProfileAudios.purpose: Read the audios a user added to their profile, paged with offset and limit.
use_when: a profile feature shows the user's chosen tracks
avoid_when: only the first audio is needed: getChat returns first_profile_audio

pitfalls.text: limit is 1-100 (default 100); page with offset against total_count.
pitfalls.cite: limit: Values between 1-100 are accepted. Defaults to 100.

pitfalls.text: For one audio, ChatFullInfo.first_profile_audio of the private chat already has it.
pitfalls.cite: ChatFullInfo.first_profile_audio: For private chats, the first audio added to the profile of the user

getUserPersonalChatMessages.purpose: Read the last 1-20 messages of the chat a user added to their profile.
use_when: a profile feature previews the user's personal channel

pitfalls.text: limit is required, 1-20.
pitfalls.cite: limit: The maximum number of messages to return; 1-20

pitfalls.text: It reads the chat currently on the profile, which the user can swap; getChat shows it as personal_chat.
pitfalls.cite: getUserPersonalChatMessages: the personal chat (i.e., the chat currently added to their profile)

pitfalls.text: The answer for a user with no personal chat (empty array or error) is not stated.

getChatShareThemeBackdrops.purpose: Read the backdrops share themes use as their background.
use_when: resolving ChatShareThemeEmoji.background_backdrop_id to a name and colors
avoid_when: on every render: the list takes no chat, cache it

pitfalls.text: Takes no parameters: one list for every chat.
pitfalls.cite: getChatShareThemeBackdrops: Requires no parameters.

pitfalls.text: Colors are RGB integers (center, edge, symbol, text).
pitfalls.cite: UniqueGiftBackdropColors.center_color: The color in the center of the backdrop in RGB format
